# Configuration

> **Instructions:** Edit `company_name` and `use_all_dates` below, then re-render the report. When `use_all_dates` is `FALSE`, `start_date` / `end_date` apply, or `include_windows` for one or more fieldwork spells (optional `locations`). Optional `exclude_periods` can drop pilot days or holidays. Company batch jobs write `_company_config.R` in the render folder.

```{r}
#| label: config

# ── User-configurable settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────
company_name     <- "All organisations"  # Organisation name shown in the report
use_all_dates    <- TRUE                 # TRUE = all submission dates in the export
include_hk_forms <- TRUE                 # FALSE for company-specific reports

start_date    <- as.Date("2026-05-01")   # Used only when use_all_dates is FALSE
end_date      <- as.Date("2026-06-13")   # Used only when use_all_dates is FALSE

# Optional extra windows. Each entry: list(start=, end=, locations=optional character).
# When non-empty and use_all_dates is FALSE, these replace start_date / end_date.
include_windows <- list()

# Invalid periods to exclude (e.g. pilot runs, system tests, public holidays)
# Add as many list() entries as needed. Use list() to apply no exclusions.
exclude_periods <- list(
  # list(start = as.Date("2026-04-16"), end = as.Date("2026-04-17")),
  # list(start = as.Date("2026-04-30"), end = as.Date("2026-04-30"))
)

if (file.exists(".Renviron")) readRenviron(".Renviron")

if (file.exists("_company_config.R")) {
  source("_company_config.R", local = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
}

source("_config_labels.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
